caption: The upgrade page opens with annual billing selected and Plus marked most popular, with a 14-day trial on each plan.
On monthly billing Lite is $15 and Plus $30 a month. Done For You adds a setup fee of $79, shown next to a crossed out $599.
Starting the Lite trial asks for a card on a Stripe page: 14 days free, then EUR 13.98 a month from 12 November 2026. We stopped before submitting.
We found no API key screen in the integrations catalog. The account email at the bottom left is hidden.
Confirmation for imports can be switched off, but switching it off for subscribers added by API needs Plus. Our name in the message preview and the account email are hidden.
The import wizard has No, they do not need to confirm selected by default, so you have to opt in to a confirmation. The account email is hidden.
Our two import addresses, both on example.com, were rejected as blocked or invalid: 2 submitted, 0 imported. The account email is hidden.
